verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover every element of the story. Gitea runs on Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD and Kubernetes; via Go it supports x86, amd64, ARM, RISC-V 64 and PowerPC. It supports SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB and MS SQL, and a Raspberry Pi 3 suffices for small workloads. Community reports independently confirm the low resource use: it runs on a $5 VPS, stays snappy on 4GB RAM and slow Atom hardware, is far lighter than GitLab, and installs as a single binary. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of the non-SQLite database backends and of the non-x86 architectures, since multi-platform and multi-database support rests mainly on marketing-level claims.
